Overview

Lion Cars is a vehicle dealership management system built with a microservices-like architecture. It provides tools for managing vehicle parkings, reservations, and inspections.

System Modules​

The system includes 3 independent modules, each available through subscription:

ModuleDescription
ParkingVehicle depositories management — add, edit, delete parking lots and vehicles within them
ReservationsVehicle reservations — customers reserve vehicles not yet available at the dealership
InspectionsUsed vehicle inspections — engine, paint, tires, interior checks with approval workflow

Tech Stack​

ComponentTechnology
DatabaseMySQL 8
BackendNode.js + Express (REST API + WebSocket)
FrontendNext.js
MobileReact Native (Expo)
State ManagementRedux Toolkit
ContainerizationDocker Compose
